source.persistence: Hibernate ORM via JPA 2.1, JNDI datasource java:jboss/datasources/CoolstoreDS

target.persistence: Hibernate ORM with Panache, Quarkus Flyway extension
target.messaging: SmallRye Reactive Messaging over AMQP (AMQ Broker / ActiveMQ Artemis)

java_communities.label: com.redhat.coolstore.model
java_communities.rationale: Lowest harmonic centrality — fewest inbound dependencies; migrate first

java_communities.label: com.redhat.coolstore.persistence
java_communities.rationale: Isolated JNDI/datasource producer; safe to migrate after model

java_communities.label: com.redhat.coolstore.utils
java_communities.rationale: Utility/transformer classes; moderate centrality; depends on model only

java_communities.label: com.redhat.coolstore.service
java_communities.rationale: Core business logic; depends on model, persistence, utils; migrate before REST

java_communities.label: com.redhat.coolstore.rest
java_communities.rationale: Highest harmonic centrality in Java layer — most connected; migrate last to reduce blast radius

risks.title: Stateful EJB session semantics
risks.mitigation: Replace with CDI @SessionScoped; validate HTTP session affinity on OpenShift Route; consider stateless cart backed by DB/Redis as fallback

risks.title: Proprietary audit library — no source available
risks.mitigation: Decompile JAR with Fernflower; write AuditService CDI bean replicating log format; obtain security sign-off on new format before removing JAR

risks.title: WebLogic T3 JNDI in InventoryNotificationMDB
risks.mitigation: Rewrite entirely as SmallRye @Incoming consumer on AMQ Artemis topic; test with Testcontainers from day one

risks.title: Flyway version gap (4.1.2 → 9.x)
risks.mitigation: Test all migration scripts against PostgreSQL in staging; run flyway repair if checksum errors; use quarkus.flyway.baseline-on-migrate=true

risks.title: 3 embedded secrets in source code
risks.mitigation: Rotate all secrets immediately in Task 1.1; inject via OpenShift Secrets; scan with git-secrets before any PR merges

risks.title: Taint flow — user input reaching sensitive sink
risks.mitigation: Apply Bean Validation (@Valid, @Min, @NotNull) to all user-supplied path/body parameters; verify remediation with OWASP ZAP in Task 10.4

phases.name: Foundation & Project Scaffolding
key_deliverables: Quarkus 3.x Maven scaffold with all extensions
Characterisation test suite (12 endpoint contracts, golden baseline)

phases.name: Model & Persistence Layer
key_deliverables: 8 JPA entity/DTO classes migrated to jakarta.persistence.*
JNDI datasource replaced with application.properties + OpenShift Secret

phases.name: Utility & Audit Replacement
key_deliverables: audit-logging-library system-scoped dep removed from pom.xml
AuditService unit tests with temp directory

phases.name: Service Layer (EJB → CDI)
key_deliverables: 7 EJB services migrated to @ApplicationScoped / @SessionScoped CDI beans
ShippingService remote EJB → local CDI bean
Service layer @QuarkusTest integration tests with Testcontainers

phases.name: Messaging (JMS MDB → SmallRye Reactive)
key_deliverables: AMQ Broker CR deployed on OpenShift (topic/orders, multicast routing)
InventoryNotificationMDB rewritten — WebLogic T3 JNDI fully removed

phases.name: REST Layer & OIDC Security
key_deliverables: CartEndpoint, ProductEndpoint, OrderEndpoint migrated to RESTEasy Reactive
Keycloak OIDC wired via quarkus-oidc extension
Taint flow remediated with Bean Validation (@Valid, @Min) (R6)
All 12 characterisation tests pass green against Quarkus

phases.name: Containerisation & OpenShift Deployment
key_deliverables: PostgreSQL, AMQ Broker, Keycloak deployed via OpenShift Operators
Kubernetes manifests: Deployment, Service, Route, ConfigMap, Secret, HPA
ArgoCD GitOps auto-sync on main branch

phases.name: Parallel Run, Validation & Cutover
key_deliverables: 48-hour parallel run with no response divergence
